# Conventional Commit format: <type>(<scope>): <subject>
#
# Type (REQUIRED):
#   feat      New feature for the user
#   fix       Bug fix
#   docs      Documentation changes only
#   style     Formatting, no logic change (black, isort, clang-format)
#   refactor  Code change that is neither fix nor feat
#   perf      Performance improvement
#   test      Adding or fixing tests
#   chore     Build process, package.xml, CMakeLists changes
#   ci        GitHub Actions, pre-commit changes
#   release   Version bump, tag, changelog
#   hotfix    Critical production fix
#
# Scope (OPTIONAL, use package name):
#   arm_description, arm_control, arm_vision, arm_ik,
#   arm_planner, arm_agents, arm_vla, arm_learning,
#   arm_dashboard, arm_moveit_config, arm_bringup,
#   esp32, docker, ci
#
# Subject: imperative mood, no period, max 72 chars
#   GOOD: "add quintic spline trajectory generation"
#   BAD:  "Added quintic spline." / "Adds quintic spline"
#
# Body (OPTIONAL, wrap at 100 chars):
#   Explain WHY the change was made, not what.
#   What problem does it solve? What was wrong before?
#
# Footer (OPTIONAL):
#   BREAKING CHANGE: <description>  ← triggers major version bump
#   Closes #<issue_number>
#   Refs #<issue_number>
#
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# EXAMPLES:
#
# feat(arm_ik): add analytical closed-form IK solver for 5-DoF arm
#
# Implements geometric decomposition:
# - θ1 from atan2(y, x) of target position
# - θ2, θ3 from law of cosines with a2=0.145m, a3=0.115m
# - θ4, θ5 from target orientation residual
#
# Benchmarked at 0.05ms avg, 0.3mm position error.
# Closes #12
#
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# fix(arm_control): clamp joint commands to soft limits before send
#
# Waist joint was occasionally reaching hardware stop due to
# floating-point accumulation error in trajectory interpolation.
# Now clips all commands to JOINT_LIMITS ± SOFT_LIMIT_MARGIN.
#
# Fixes #31
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
